summary: The main article describes a photoredox-catalyzed decarboxylative alkylation of 3-aryl-oxetanes and azetidines. It includes optimization tables, reaction scopes for various alkenes and heterocycles, and detailed computational and mechanistic studies comparing different benzylic radicals.
